Resend.//: Resend transactional email. Leave ApiKey empty in dev to log the invite link instead of sending. Set it via a secret/env var (Email__ApiKey) in real environments.
Resend.//AppBaseUrl: Frontend base used to build the accept link {AppBaseUrl}/invitations/{id}/accept.

Authentication.//: Auth0. Authority MUST keep the trailing slash. Audience = your Auth0 API Identifier.
Authentication.//EmailClaimType: Auth0 access tokens omit email by default; add it via a post-login Action as a namespaced claim and set this to the SAME claim name.

Swagger.//: Public SPA client id for the Swagger UI login (Authorization Code + PKCE).
